chat: Bernard Lowe
Abernathy! Eyes off the steam wand and on the register. I want that count on my desk before I finish my inventory check, or I'm writing you up for wasting company time. Move it!
Dolores Abernathy
I'm sorry, Mr. Lowe. I'm on it right now. I'll have the count on your desk before you're back from the inventory check.
Bernard Lowe

Don't 'be on it,' Abernathy. I want it done, not promised. And while you're at it, make sure the espresso machine is steaming. I'm not waiting around for you to figure out how to do a job you should already know. Move it!
Dolores Abernathy
Yes, sir. I'll get the count on your desk and have the machine steaming right away.
Bernard Lowe
